prompt: Why does the lesson gather the limits of every number into one place?

choices.why: It is the point, not decoration.

prompt: Which of these are legitimate uses of a team's numbers, according to the lesson? Choose every one that applies.

choices.text: The team improving its own system
choices.why: The first use, and the main one.

choices.text: Saying no to a demand with evidence
choices.why: The defensive use.

choices.text: Because the director outranks the team
choices.why: Rank is not the test.

choices.text: Because the other teams were slower
choices.why: No comparison was made.

choices.text: It decides about a way of working
choices.why: Right. Not about the people working.
Publicity is not the test.

prompt: Put the three questions for a new use of the numbers in the order the lesson asks them.
